left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Federated boxers
  -  Over 18 years
  -  Male
  -  With non-specific back pain that does not incapacitate them for the realization of their sport or work activity

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Federated boxers  [AND] with lumbar injury with medical diagnosis
  -  Who are  [OR] or have been treated by pharmacological  [OR] or physiotherapy in the last 6 months
  -  Presenting allergies  [OR] or alterations of the skin
  -  Not sign the informed consent document
